titleNative: 闭嘴恶龙我不想再跟你带孩子了
synopsis: The dragon slayer Leon was defeated and captured by the Silver Dragon Queen. With his life on the line, he tried to use forbidden magic to curse the dragon queen, but the curse had unexpected side effects, and the queen lost control as they had a one-night stand. He thought that the shame she would carry for the rest of her life would be enough to fulfill his life's purpose as a dragon slayer. But two years later, when Leon opened his eyes, he found a young dragon girl with a tail sleeping next to him…

synopsis: The protagonist after an accident is "reborn" in another world as an abandoned child and is entrusted with other abandoned children like him. In order to survive, using vast knowledge of previous world, he teaches them new things...starting from how to prepare and cultivate a land. Little by little, orphans gathered, and upon hearing rumors of a new village, others began to migrate. The group that had been nothing but children had become a village before anyone have realized. And then various countries in the surroundings started to have an eye on it… This is the epic tale of the man who would later be known as the Divine Emperor.

In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. synopsis: Your "welcome home" is the perfect remedy. Tsukasa Shiozaki has secretly been in love with Yukihito Kuze, a regular at the restaurant where he works who often comes in with his girlfriend. But one day everything changes. “If you don't have anywhere to go, why not come to my place?” With that sudden invitation made to Yukihito, Tsukasa’s ordinary life takes an unexpected turn. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Notes: - All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases. All Bangai-hen (番外編) published on Pixiv Comic were not included in any of the volumes. - Includes five extra chapters.

As he travels from city to city, country to country playing for money, he hopes that he regains his memory.
